pages.text: The approved countries for remote work are Argentina and Uruguay. Working from another country requires written approval from People Operations.
Full-time employees receive twenty business days of annual leave each calendar year. Leave requests are submitted in the people portal.
A lost company device must be reported to the Security team within one hour. Include the device identifier and last known location.
Production credentials must be rotated every ninety days. Emergency credentials are rotated immediately after each use.
